description:
pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:1146 LintRunner has fields { lints: Vec<Box<dyn Lint>>, bundle_version: Cow<'static, str> }. Both are Clone-able: Cow is Clone-by-derive, and Box<dyn Lint>: Clone is supplied by the LintClone supertrait blanket impl (lib.rs:689-693). So `#[derive(Clone)]` on LintRunner compiles and produces the correct behavior.

It is not derived. The struct ships with no Clone impl.

Same for pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:1114 DeviationRunner { runner: LintRunner, store: DeviationStore }. DeviationStore already derives Clone (line 854). Once LintRunner derives Clone, DeviationRunner can too.

Why it matters:

* AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 explicitly names 'callbacks-not-closed-structs admit caller-side caching by design' and 'public result/result types MUST derive Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq … cache-friendliness'. LintRunner is the entry-point closure for evaluation; a caller that wants to keep a base runner and several parameter-tweaked clones can't, because Clone isn't derived.
* The infrastructure to make this work (LintClone supertrait) already exists and is justified in the rustdoc by 'apply_parameter_overrides clones lints internally to provide atomicity'. The internal clone path uses clone_box exactly because Vec<Box<dyn Lint>> isn't Clone-derivable without LintClone — and that bridge is already built. Not exposing the Clone derive leaves the bridge half-finished.
* Finding-prefix existing .26 audits Send+Sync coverage but not Clone coverage.

Fix: add #[derive(Clone)] to LintRunner (remove the existing manual Debug impl if derive(Debug) also satisfies — manual Debug currently elides the lint list, so keep manual Debug). Same on DeviationRunner.

Filed P2: this is about API-shape closure (every user of the runner expects to be able to clone), pre-1.0 free to fix.
title: LintRunner and DeviationRunner missing Clone derive despite Box<dyn Lint>: Clone via LintClone supertrait
